label: Knitwear — jumpers, cardigans, knit tops
note: Authored, never generated. Structurally close to `top`, but the macros are texture-led rather than print-led: gauge, stitch pattern, cable relief and rib depth are what a knitwear customer inspects, and they need raking light to read at all. A flat, evenly-lit macro of a knit shows nothing.
preserve_fields: the yarn colour and any heather, marl or fleck in it
the knit gauge — the exact stitch size and density
the stitch pattern and any cable, rib or texture, in its exact scale and placement
the neckline and its rib depth
the shoulder line, sleeve shape and cuff rib
the hem rib depth and the body length

ref_descriptions.front: the front of a knitted jumper photographed flat on a headless mannequin
ref_descriptions.back: the BACK of the same jumper photographed on a mannequin
ref_descriptions.detail: a macro of the same jumper's knit structure, neckline and cuff

blocks.keep_onmodel: Keep the SAME {{campaign.pronoun.noun}} (identical face, hair, skin tone and build), the SAME {{product.short_name}} with its yarn colour, knit gauge and stitch pattern unchanged, the SAME {{wardrobe_short}}, and the SAME {{campaign.set_short}} and {{campaign.light_short}}.
blocks.must_preserve: MUST PRESERVE EXACTLY from the references, unchanged: {{product.garment}}; and {{preserve_fields}}. Do not resize the gauge, redraw the stitch pattern, or shift where a cable or rib sits on the body. Do not add any extra text, logo or graphic anywhere on the garment.
blocks.tail: {{campaign.grade}}, sharp focus, no motion blur, no extra text or logos.
blocks.no_person: ABSOLUTELY NO human presence: no skin, no neck, no shoulders, no hands, no body underneath the knit. Nothing but cloth.
blocks.flatlay_setup: flat-lay product photography, no person and no mannequin anywhere in the frame. The {{category.garment_noun_short}} is laid flat and face-up on {{campaign.flatlay_surface}} and photographed from directly above

prompt: {{ref_roles_sentence}}
Produce a square macro detail photograph of the KNIT ALONE — {{blocks.flatlay_setup}}, the knit relaxed and lying flat with no stretch.

Framing: the frame is filled edge to edge by the knit at its true gauge, with the stitch pattern — cable, rib, moss or plain — centred and running true, so individual loops and the twist of the yarn are resolved.

LIGHT: low raking side light skimming across the surface, so every stitch casts a small shadow and the relief of the cable and rib stands up. Flat frontal light would render this knit as flat colour and destroy the shot.
{{blocks.no_person}}

MUST PRESERVE EXACTLY from Image 1: the yarn colour including any marl or fleck, the exact gauge and stitch count, the stitch pattern and its scale, and the yarn's fibre halo. Do not resize the gauge or redraw the pattern. Do not add any extra text, logo or graphic.
Extreme detail macro product photography, 100mm macro look, razor-sharp yarn and loop detail, shallow raking shadow, flat even framing.
